title: Em to Am Focus: 3 Easy Songs for Beginners (JustinGuitar)
summary: In this concise beginner lesson, JustinGuitar centers on using E minor (Em) and A minor (Am) chords for strumming practice. He emphasizes keeping a simple, consistent rhythm as the key to successful chord changes, then presents several songs that demonstrate Em/Am progressions. Examples include Sing by Ed Sheeran, Moves Like Jagger by Maroon 5, I Belong To You by Lenny Kravitz, and Use Me by Bill Withers. He also references practical practice aids like strumming patterns, the Beginner Song Course app, and guitaraoke play-along, and invites viewers to share their practice videos and engage with the community for feedback.
